technique_de_realisation: Drain crab and lobster meat. Remove cartilage and chop lobster. Set aside.
Melt 1/4 cup butter and sauté vegetables. Set aside.
Melt remaining butter, blend in flour and cook on low heat for 2 minutes.
Gradually add milk and cheese, whisking well until melted. Season to taste.
Add seafood and vegetables, mix well and pour into a large casserole dish.
Top casserole with fresh bread crumbs or cubes.
Bake uncovered at 400 F for 30 minutes or until scallops are opaque.
